title: An AI-Based Decision-Support Pipeline for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.02088v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) forecasts can support low-carbon energy systems, but deployed sites may have only short and incomplete records. Physical and hybrid methods can be sensitive to weather inputs, calibration, and timestamp-alignment, while individual machine learning models may capture different parts of the forecasting problem. We study hourly day-ahead PV forecasting at a United Kingdom charging station using one year of inverter measurements, with 9.25% of hours missing. The pipeline checks timestamp-alignment, derives solar and clearness features, adds short-term weather context, and combines five complementary models using non-negative least squares stacking, with the combination fitted only on validation observations. We compare against smart persistence, a weather-scaled baseline that carries the previous day's PV behaviour forward using target-day irradiance. translated_title: 一种基于人工智能的日前光伏预测决策支持流程
translated_abstract: 可靠的光伏（PV）预测可以支持低碳能源系统，但已部署的场地可能只有短暂且不完整的记录。物理和混合方法可能对天气输入、校准和时间戳对齐较为敏感，而单个机器学习模型可能只能捕捉预测问题的部分内容。我们利用英国某充电站一年的逆变器测量数据（其中9.25%的小时数据缺失），研究其日前逐小时光伏预测。该流程检查时间戳对齐、推导太阳辐射和晴朗度特征、添加短期天气上下文信息，并使用非负最小二乘堆叠方法将五个互补模型组合起来（组合仅基于验证观测数据拟合）。我们将其与“智能持续性”基线进行比较，该基线利用目标日辐照度将前一天的PV行为向前推演。结合回溯性天气数据，组合模型降低了（预测误差）……
tldr: 该研究针对数据缺失严重的实际光伏站点，提出了一套包含时间戳校验、特征工程和非负最小二乘堆叠五模型组合的AI日前预测流程，在英国充电站数据上优于智能持续性基线。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an AI-based day-ahead PV forecasting pipeline for sites with incomplete records, combining five complementary models via non-negative least squares stacking, which outperforms smart persistence on UK charging station data.
